full_page.content:
1947, May 1
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God,
Father Solanus Casey, OF.M.Cap.
V. Sister Miriam James 363 W Hth Street Eugene, Oregon.
Blest be God in His angels and saints ! May Ist 1947
God bless you Sister Miriam James. After finishing your letters for the Ist time last night I started to write both of you and your cousin Sister Mary Eileen Clare. I meant to get them done but it was nearing 11 p.m. and my eyes threatened a strike if I continues. I wrote your dear mother a few months ago when she was quite low. Thank God, I understand she improved some since. . . She seemed to pick up wonderfully two years ago at the happy reunion and Solemn Ist holy Mass. . . But how short the joys of earth! - and the sorrows too! Deo Gr.
What a glorious contrast in Heaven. Fr. Sol.
(on the reverse side of above card he wrote) :
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary, Huntington, Ind. (printed) Clerical Novitiate - at present 23 novices, promising young men. We could place fifty priests tomorrow if we had them for the home and foriegn missions. Pray the Lord of the vineyard that He send laborers. Fr. Solanus
(And on a Seraphic Mass Association card he wrote : )
V. Sister Miriam James
Perpetual Member
January 13th 1948
God bless you Sister M.J. Keep well - with mother and all. Praised be Jesus Christ ! Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Sister Bernadine Casey, S.N.J.M. Fort Wright College W. 4000 Randolph Rd. Spokane, Wa. 99204
